newsitem.title: USA: Virginia jobless rate dips to 4 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Virginia jobless rate dips to 4 percent in March.

text.p: Virginia's unemployment rate dipped to four percent in March from 4.4 percent in February, the state Employment Commisison reported.
The rate was the lowest for March sine 1990, when it was 3.8 percent.
The commission said 19,727 initial jobless claims were filed in March, down from 20,205 in February and the lowest total for March since 1979.
The commission said mild weather and the early Easter played a role in the improvement, along with a strong economy.
The average weekly wage for manufacturing jobs was $520.38 in March, an increase of $11.15 from February.
